rows.ARS:
Medium red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACtop
Exhibition name: Legend
rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, circa 1983).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) in 1992 as 'Legend'.
rows.Bloom: Red. Moderate, fruity fragrance. 45 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, very double, borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, reflexed bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Few or no prickles/thorns. Large, dark green foliage.

Height: 47" to 5' (120 to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
